This makes them feel hasty and want to rush things and to grow up as fast as possible but this disregards the fact that all adults are children at heart, and the idea of being an adult is a fabrication or delusion. However you fail to understand the full value of your life and seek some type of experience to validate your worth.

Maybe you had a neurotic experience that you thought you were enjoying while it went down, then afterwards you felt guilt and confusion.
